## Change

Describe the result and link the implementation issue.

## Checks

List the exact checks run and any limits.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the issue scope and read-only v1 boundary.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic data and run without a live account.
- [ ] Every function has useful Rust documentation, including private helpers.
- [ ] Public documentation, examples, and failure cases match actual behavior.
- [ ] Usage and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] No credentials, account snapshots, or proprietary content are included.
- [ ] No pending capability is described as implemented.
